parsed.summary: Lot LOT-0017 consisting of heavy-duty wiring harnesses from Atlas Wire and Cable at Wacky Wheels San Antonio, built from 2027-02-22 to 2027-02-24, was placed on hold. A total of 86 unsold vehicles were stopped from sale at 36 dealers, and 94 owners of sold vehicles were contacted.
parsed.decision_reason: The system acted on a confirmed incident because identifiers and dates were resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write. The incident type handled was quality_hold.
